commands.command:
. /workspace/.setup/rust-env.sh
python3 tools/wtime-bench/compare.py --baseline target/performance/P031-before --candidate tools/wtime-bench/target/release/wtime-bench --candidate-mode decoded --selection scalar --pairs 30 --build-growth-explanation-file docs/benchmarks/performance/P031-build-decision.md --output target/performance/P031 > target/performance/P031-run.log 2>&1
commands.name: comparison

counts.warm_calibration_policy_limit: All 85 scalar workloads use bounded shared-batch calibration with both sides confirmed at or above 20 ms during calibration (164 typed-driver records and six legacy single-case records). Later timed observations can fall below 20 ms.

comparison.warm_calibration_limit: All 85 scalar workloads use bounded shared-batch calibration with both sides confirmed at or above 20 ms during calibration (164 typed-driver records and six legacy single-case records). Later timed observations can fall below 20 ms.

coverage_limits: The scalar workload and stage totals are derived from the immutable registry and independently checked against the journal.

The candidate reuses empty decoded guest-invocation outer frame, operand and prompt buffers; host-only invocations and the Reference executor remain outside this pool. Nested frames and references are dropped before idle retention, and published results and detached continuations own independent storage.
Focused path proof and full suites are correctness evidence; speed claims require the separate predeclared gate result.

All 85 scalar warm workloads use bounded shared-batch calibration with both sides confirmed at or above 20 ms (164 typed-driver and six legacy single-case records). Later timing observations may be shorter.
Synthetic Python checks establish tooling behavior only; they establish no guest correctness or speed result.
The single quiet build pair satisfies the predeclared budget gate but does not establish a robust compile-time improvement.

development_failures.correction: Corrected the P030 verified_file schema, then revalidated existing successful Rust/Python logs with a robust unittest parser and executed only remaining suites.

Added the missing execution::Frame import to the new private activation module, then completed 13/14 focused, 221 full-default and 80 diagnostic-performance checks before the single quiet candidate budget sample. No quiet build sample was retried.

An agent overwrote a reviewed /tmp draft. The overwritten draft was not used on real data. The recovery restored tested calibration and legacy observation APIs; root added metadata checks before the actual extraction passed. The original reviewed draft could not be recovered byte-for-byte; reconstructed material checks and the actual executed extractor are retained.
